```{python}
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import re


try:
    with open("../../../data/gutenberg/moby.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        moby_lines = f.readlines()
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Couldn't find that file — check the filename and location.")

while not moby_lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
    moby_lines = moby_lines[1:]     # chop off the first line
moby_lines = moby_lines[1:]         # chop off the *** START line itself

while not moby_lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
    moby_lines = moby_lines[:-1]    # chop off the last line
moby_lines = moby_lines[:-1]        # chop off the *** END line itself

moby_text = "".join(moby_lines)



try:
    with open("../../../data/gutenberg/rnj.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        rnj_lines = f.readlines()
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Couldn't find that file — check the filename and location.")

while not rnj_lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
    rnj_lines = rnj_lines[1:]     # chop off the first line
rnj_lines = rnj_lines[1:]         # chop off the *** START line itself

while not rnj_lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
    rnj_lines = rnj_lines[:-1]    # chop off the last line
rnj_lines = rnj_lines[:-1]        # chop off the *** END line itself

rnj_text = "".join(rnj_lines)

#cleaning
import re

moby_words = re.split(r"[\W]+", moby_text.lower())
moby_words = [w for w in moby_words if w != ""]

rnj_words = re.split(r"[\W]+", rnj_text.lower())
rnj_words = [w for w in rnj_words if w != ""]



moby_ttr = len(set(moby_words)) / len(moby_words)
rnj_ttr = len(set(rnj_words)) / len(rnj_words)
print("moby TTR:", moby_ttr)
print("rnj Park TTR:", rnj_ttr)

#other stuff

moby_ttr_10000 = len(set(moby_words[:10000])) / len(moby_words[:10000])
rnj_ttr_10000 = len(set(rnj_words[:10000])) / len(rnj_words[:10000])
print("moby TTR (10,000 words):", moby_ttr_10000)
print("rnj Park TTR (10,000 words):", rnj_ttr_10000)


moby_wd_len_total = 0
for w in moby_words:
    moby_wd_len_total += len(w)
moby_avg_word_len = moby_wd_len_total / len(moby_words)

rnj_wd_len_total = 0
for w in rnj_words:
    rnj_wd_len_total += len(w)
rnj_avg_word_len = rnj_wd_len_total / len(rnj_words)

print("rnj Average Word Length:", rnj_avg_word_len)
print("moby Average Word Length:", moby_avg_word_len)

#ly rates 

moby_ly =[w for w in moby_words if w .endswith("ly")]
rnj_ly=[w for w in rnj_words if w .endswith("ly")]

moby_ly_rate = len(moby_ly) / len(moby_words) * 1000
rnj_ly_rate = len(rnj_ly) / len(rnj_words) * 1000

print ("moby ly:",moby_ly_rate)
print ("rnj ly:",rnj_ly_rate)

#un rates
moby_un =[w for w in moby_words if w .startswith("un")]
rnj_un=[w for w in rnj_words if w .startswith("un")]

moby_un_rate = len(moby_un) / len(moby_words) * 1000
rnj_un_rate = len(rnj_un) / len(rnj_words) * 1000

print ("moby un:",moby_un_rate)
print ("rnj un:",rnj_un_rate)

moby_ing =[w for w in moby_words if w .endswith("ing")]
rnj_ing=[w for w in rnj_words if w .endswith("ing")]

moby_ing_rate = len(moby_ing) / len(moby_words) * 1000

print ("rnj ing :",rnj_ing_rate)

rnj_ness=[w for w in rnj_words if w .endswith("ness")]

print ("rnj ness:",rnj_ness_rate)
```
